title: Arrive and wander Shibuya
call: A perfect first day. Sunny and dry on every source: 0% all day from JMA and tenki.jp, a high of 25° about 14:00, light north-easterly breeze. Clear air for Shibuya Sky at 16:00, about 23° on the deck with sunset just after 17:00. Down to 18° by 21:00, so a light layer for the evening.
